/root/work/sign-product/send-venv/bin/python - <<'EOF'
import json
p='/root/worktrees/dealroom-sign-edd/docs/edd/briefs/counterparty-c2a-gate3-r28.jsonl'
uses=[];res={}
for line in open(p):
    try: o=json.loads(line)
    except: continue
    def walk(x):
        if isinstance(x,dict):
            if x.get('type')=='tool_use' and x.get('name')=='Bash': uses.append(x['id'])
            if x.get('type')=='tool_result': res[x.get('tool_use_id')]=x.get('content')
            for v in x.values(): walk(v)
        elif isinstance(x,list):
            for v in x: walk(v)
    walk(o)
for i in (31,32,33,36,40):
    c=res.get(uses[i]); 
    if isinstance(c,list): c='\n'.join(d.get('text','') for d in c if isinstance(d,dict))
    print('=====',i); print(c[:3500])
EOF
